name: io.github.HugoRS00/wiz-by-tradingwizard
title: Wiz by TradingWizard
description: AI chart analysis, market data, alerts and watchlists. A signal is analysis, never an order.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Returns the current market picture: crypto and stock Fear & Greed, altcoin season, BTC dominance, VIX, the US 10-year yield, market regime, top movers and how the Wiz bots lean overall. A metric that is unavailable is null, with freshness details.

tools.name: get_market_price
tools.description: Returns the live price for one stock, crypto, forex, futures or index symbol, with today's change. For a US stock outside regular hours, extendedHours holds the pre-market or after-hours price.

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: Returns a list of assets with live quotes for a market category: top 100, crypto, stocks, ETFs, forex, indices or futures. Up to 50 rows; a missing price is null.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Returns recent verified public statements by well-known market figures, with the affected ticker, sentiment, a likelihood-to-move score, the source and how far the asset has moved since. Can be filtered by symbols.

symbols.description: Optional comma-separated tickers to filter, e.g. "TSLA,DOGE,NVDA".

tools.name: get_bot_consensus
tools.description: Returns how the Wiz bots lean on one symbol: bullish, bearish and neutral counts, the net lean and a confidence percentage.

tools.name: get_global_bots
tools.description: Returns the public Wiz bots with symbol, current bias, likelihood, latest read and setup levels. Read only. Can be filtered by symbol.

symbol.description: Optional ticker filter, e.g. BTC or BTCUSDT.

limit.description: Max bots. Without the plan at most 12; members default 25 and max 50.

tools.name: get_ranked_opportunities
tools.description: Returns the symbols the public Wiz bots watch, ranked by how close each is to a setup, with bias, likelihood, confidence and scan time. Entry zone, stop, target and risk to reward appear where the account includes them.

symbol.description: Optional ticker filter, e.g. BTC, AAPL.

tools.name: get_live_quotes
tools.description: Widget helper: the live price and today's % change for up to 20 symbols, each marked live, delayed, closed or unavailable. Read-only, public, cached for a few seconds. Free for everyone; no account needed.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Widget helper: bounded price candles for one symbol, for the chart. range is 1d, 5d, 1m, 3m, 1y; at most 300 candles. Read-only, public. Free for everyone; no account needed.
